sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:184798
Court No. - 75
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 38553 of 2023
Applicant :- Dr. Mohammad Imtiyaj

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutos Kumar Pandey,Nitin Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. By means of this bail application applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.54 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 506, 120-B IPC and Section 3, 5(1) of the UP Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act, 2021, Police Station Kotwali, District Fatehpur, during the pendency of trial.

entities.text: UP Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act, 2021
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case with a view to cause unnecessary harassment and to victimize him.

In the present case neither he is not named in the FIR nor any evidence has been produced that he had provided any amount on the particular date and time to a particular person or had enticed any person.
His name has come into picture in the additional statement of the informant which had been recorded by the investigating officer with ulterior motive only to falsely implicate him.

It is also argued that it is a case of parity as another accused Prof. (Dr.) Sarvjeet Herbert has also been enlarged on bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated Dr. Mohammad Imtiyaj vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50927018/
1 02.05.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.19585 of 2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.19585 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It has also been argued that no incriminating material has been recovered from his possession and no specific role has been assigned to him.
It is further contended that in two similar cases the Apex Court has stayed the proceedings against the applicant.
The cases in which the applicant was implicated falsely has been mentioned in paragraph-19 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application.
There is no likelihood of his abscondence or tampering with the evidence.
The applicant is in jail since11.08.2023.
In case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the bail application but he could not dispute the submission made above.
5. Having regard to the submissions made but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant - Dr. Mohammad Imtiyaj, involved in the aforesaid case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the conditions that he:
(i) shall appear on the date fixed by the trial court;
(ii) shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(iii) shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Shahroz  Dr. Mohammad Imtiyaj vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50927018/
